_doc: Earlier runtime/vq_switch.py revisions whose OUTPUT is byte-identical to the current runtime for every artifact WITHOUT vq_skipzero, at their own baked defaults. check-bundle reports a bundle carrying one of these as STALE (rebundle to pick up the listed gains), not FAIL. An entry is added only with tests/test_runtime_equivalence.py passing against it; that test reads this file.

revisions.gains: decode: VQ_D4_DEVCB_WALK +9.1% (d4 K8192/16384, F181), VQ_D2_WALK +11.7% (packed d2, F182), VQ_DECODE_XKREP +5.1% (35B, F179), stacked +13.7% on 35B-3.8; skipzero row-table support
none in vq_dense itself (comment-only change); the bundled vq_switch half carries the decode gains
